messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: OLrmAIz5lGg71vI2WOp7zQ

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "OLrmAIz5lGg71vI2WOp7zQ"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: The ruin gates loom ahead.
scenes.visual_description: Crumbled stone gates choked with ivy, tattered royal banners hanging limp from twisted poles, and the glass_diver adjusting his helmet in the reflection of a puddle.

scenes.caption: Mara unfolds a cursed map.
scenes.visual_description: Mara spreads a parchment across a broken statue base; the ink shifts as she points; tin_fox sniffs the air nearby.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp flickers a warning.
scenes.visual_description: Inside a collapsed chapel, the oracle lamp sits on an altar; its flame eye glows red as it whispers of a trap in the tower.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks the path.
scenes.visual_description: A figure slumped against a crumbling wall, ledger under head, stamp papers fluttering; tin_fox nudges a boot to no avail.

scenes.caption: Mirror doors reflect a false corridor.
scenes.visual_description: Tall silver doors in a dark archway; glass_diver peers into his own reflection—the reflection moves differently.

scenes.caption: Mara marks the tower on her map.
scenes.visual_description: Mara stands on a toppled bell, shading a sketched tower; the ink glows faintly; tin_fox barks a metallic yip.

scenes.caption: The cursed tower door creaks open.
scenes.visual_description: Rusty iron door etched with winding symbols; glass_diver presses a hand to it—frost spreads from his fingers.

scenes.caption: Inside the tower, a spiral of whispers.
scenes.visual_description: Narrow spiral stairs with dust motes that form faces; oracle lamp swings from glass_diver's belt, casting jittery shadows.

scenes.caption: Tin fox finds a hidden door.
scenes.visual_description: Tin_fox scratches at a section of wall that sounds hollow; Mara traces a line on her map and nods.

scenes.caption: The tax collector sleeps on a ledger pile.
scenes.visual_description: Piled ledgers form a makeshift bed; sleeping_tax_collector snores, a stamp stuck to his cheek; a key hangs from his belt.

scenes.caption: Glass diver reaches through a mirror.
scenes.visual_description: Frosted mirror in the tower room; glass_diver's arm vanishes into the silver surface, emerging somewhere else entirely.

scenes.caption: Mara consults the oracle lamp.
scenes.visual_description: In a dusty library, Mara holds the lamp close; its flame whispers directions, and tin_fox listens at the door.

scenes.caption: The armored patrol marches past.
scenes.visual_description: Hollow armor suits clank down a corridor, halberds raised; glass_diver presses flat against a alcove, holding still.

scenes.caption: Tin fox retrieves the key from the tax collector.
scenes.visual_description: Tin_fox uses metal teeth to gently lift the key from the tax collector's belt; the sleeping figure mutters in his sleep.

scenes.caption: The final magic door resists.
scenes.visual_description: A door of solid obsidian with a keyhole that glows; glass_diver inserts the key—the door shudders but stays shut.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp unlocks the door with light.
scenes.visual_description: Oracle lamp shines its eye into the keyhole; the door groans open to reveal a bridge beyond.

scenes.caption: The rescue party crosses the bridge.
scenes.visual_description: Stone bridge spanning a misty chasm; tattered banners on both sides; glass_diver carries the lamp, Mara follows with her map, tin_fox scampers ahead.

scenes.caption: The bridge collapses behind them.
scenes.visual_description: The bridge crumbles into the mist; on the far side, the party looks back at the ruined city; sleeping_tax_collector is still seen napping on the broken edge.
